# The Org

The Org provides company org charts, people and position search, manager lookup, lead lists, and account usage data.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/the-org/.

## Actions

- **Estimate Position Search Cost** (read-only): Estimate the credits required for one page of a position search without consuming credits.
- **Get Current Usage** (read-only): Return the connected account's current credit allowance, billing interval, reset date, additional credits, overages, and unlimited status.
- **Get Manager** (read-only): WARNING.
- **Get Org Chart** (read-only): Return a company's current v1.2 org chart or board as a flat node list.
- **Get Usage History** (read-only): Return daily or monthly historical usage for one API product over an inclusive date range.
- **List People Lists** (read-only): Return people and lead lists owned by or shared with the connected account, one page at a time.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Find companies by name, domain, or email without consuming credits.
- **Search Positions** (read-only): Search people and positions using company, role, hierarchy, location, funding, and contact filters.
